title: How API changes flow into Stripe's developer products
summary: When a Stripe engineer makes changes to an API, merging the PR is just the beginning. Stripe maintains a vast developer product suite that needs to stay in sync with the API changes we frequently ship:

About the authors


### Mikael Mello


Mikael is a software engineer on the API Services team, where they build the platform powering end-to-end API development at Stripe, including highly-reliable API gateway services. Originally from Brazil and a graduate of Universidade de Brasília, he's passionate about API design and the craft of building well-designed products.

Anna Mason is a technical writer at Stripe working across the engineering organization.
